environment.network: browser context offline; external DNS disabled

procedure: Load the public 0.8.11 extension in an empty isolated Chromium profile, with networking disabled.
Seed only the two checked-in synthetic state/runtime fixtures through the protected storage adapter and account store.
Inspect the ten known archive values in native chrome.storage.local; confirm encrypted envelopes and a non-extractable native IndexedDB CryptoKey.

Open the real action popup through chrome.action.openPopup; call the normal GET_STATE and EXPORT_AI_INPUT handlers for each synthetic UID. A popup.html opened as a browser tab is deliberately not an authorised action-popup sender.
Stop the extension worker through ServiceWorker.stopWorker and observe runningStatus=stopped; wake it with normal popup messages and repeat the original-key, original-ciphertext and export checks.
Close the isolated browser completely, reopen the same persistent profile without reseeding, and repeat all read/export and persistence checks.
boundaries: Synthetic native-browser lifecycle acceptance; no live BOSS collection or second real-account switching test.
No whole-library legacy plaintext migration and no claim that every old retained copy is encrypted.
Storage key names, lightweight popup cache and user exports are outside the encrypted archive boundary.
A key in the same browser profile does not protect against control of that browser or operating system.
This record is not Chrome Web Store approval or a test of every supported browser version.
